 🔥 El Mala rocks Cologne: FC Köln tear Union to pieces 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article After two games without scoring, 1. FC Köln have roared back with a bang. In their cup clash against Union Berlin, rising star Saïd El Mala in particular has put the visitors’ defence through the wringer. 
 Köln 5 Union Berlin 0 Today Full time The 20-year-old has played a major part in Köln’s commanding 3–0 lead, scoring twice and setting up Linton Maina’s goal. It’s the classic ketchup-bottle effect: nothing comes out, then suddenly it all pours out at once.
